Not only does this include the provision of education and ensuring learning, but molding the character, morals and value system of the child as well. St. Vincent's Academy provides the foundation needed to view the world as a limitless space providing innumerable opportunities to shine. We strive to provide education that explores plethora of learning opportunities and grooms every aspect of the child’s personality. We have a conducive ambiance for teaching and learning. Our dedicated and committed teachers always encourage our students for innovation, exploration, creativity and to excel not only in academics but also in extra-curricular activities by enhancing their skills in new avenues. We are a platform extending valuable opportunities for our young talents to showcase their imagination and creativity. We are confident that our school will continue to rise higher, and we are grateful for the constant support. Email: svaburdwan@gmail.com Phone: (+91) 8145 730 807 Chandan Jha (Principal) I am always attracted to the thought that ‘Home is the first school and school is the second home.’ The parents are our biggest strength, support and confidence to move ahead. I thank you dear parents, guardians and well wishers for having bestowed your faith and hope in us and entrusting your children to our school. We always look forward to your constant help and support in providing quality education. I gratefully acknowledge and deeply appreciate the commitment, vision and the hard work of our Honorable Chairman Shri Sanjay Kumar Gupta in contributing to the mission of education. We are confident that our school will continue to rise higher, and we are grateful for the constant support.
